rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the period or condition of being an apprentice.

example.english: After completing my three-year apprenticeship, I can finally work on my own.
example.traditional: 我捱完三年學徒期，終於可以出師喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaai4 jyun4 saam1 nin4 hok6 tou4 kei4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceot1 si1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when referring to the organized system under which apprentices are trained for a set time.

example.english: This workshop trains young people in cabinetmaking through an apprenticeship.
example.traditional: 呢間工場靠學徒制培訓後生仔學整傢俬。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 coeng4 kaau3 hok6 tou4 zai3 pui4 fan3 hau6 saang1 zai2 hok6 zing2 gaa1 si1
